requested_by: The Left, PPE, Renew, S&D, Verts/ALE
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text: Recognises Edmundo González Urrutia as the legitimate and democratically elected President of Venezuela; also recognises María Corina Machado as the leader of the democratic forces in Venezuela, since she was elected at the primaries of the Unitary Platform in 2023 with 92.35 % of the vote;
